theme: Luxury Pink + Royal Princess + Floral Baby + Cute Teddy
archetype: Hybrid of Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) & Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury)
vibe: Cinematic, emotional, magical, interactive, high-end premium.

primary.description: Pearl White for the main background to keep it airy and elegant.

secondary.description: Soft Baby Blush Pink for sections and cards.

accent.description: Gold and Rose Gold for borders, glowing effects, and accents. Deep Rose Charcoal for text (Never use pure black).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than standard. Lots of breathing room.

ganesha.description: Ganesha idol for the welcome splash screen. Apply a drop-shadow and soft gold glow.

teddy_motif.description: Teddy bear motif to be used in 'Meet Our Princess' section as a side decoration.

animations.particles: Use Framer Motion to create a global ParticleBackground component with floating petals/sparkles continuously moving upwards with varying opacities and delays.
animations.scroll_reveal: Wrap every section in a motion.div with whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 50 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: 'easeOut' }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}.
animations.image_reveal: Images should have a slow scale-down effect inside a hidden overflow container to create a cinematic parallax reveal.
animations.glow_pulse: Apply a subtle infinite drop-shadow pulse to the Ganesha idol and key buttons.

components.name: WelcomeSplash
components.description: Full screen intro. Shows Ganesha image, 'ॐ श्री गणेशाय नमः', and Language Selection (English / हिंदी). Must unmount or fade out entirely upon selection to reveal the main app.

components.name: AudioController
components.description: Fixed floating button at top right. Toggles ambient background music. Use an HTML5 <audio> element. Button rotates when playing.

components.name: HeroSection
components.description: Full height mobile-first hero. Background has the floral_background texture with very low opacity. 'Little Princess Has Arrived' / 'हमारी नन्ही परी आ गई है'. Main baby placeholder image in a gold-bordered oval or arch frame.

components.name: EventDetails
components.description: Shows Ceremony Date (19-05-2026), Time (7 PM). Includes a Live Countdown Timer component (days, hours, mins, secs).

components.name: MemoryGallery
components.description: Horizontal scrolling carousel of baby placeholders. Use Framer Motion drag='x' or standard flex-overflow with hide-scrollbar. Images must have rounded-2xl and soft shadows.

components.name: LocationRSVP
components.description: Address: House A/9 Biscoman Colony, Patna. Embedded generic Google Map iframe. Buttons for 'Get Directions' (links to maps) and 'WhatsApp RSVP' (links to wa.me).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use the `data-testid` attribute exactly as specified or intuitively for other interactive elements.
The entire site must be bilingual. Create a simple Context or state variable `language` ('en' or 'hi') to swap text instantly.
Use Tailwind's arbitrary values for specific colors if needed (e.g., `text-[#4A3B42]`).
Never use pure black for text or overlays. Use `bg-[#4A3B42]/50` for overlays if needed.
Prioritize mobile viewport. Desktop should look like a centered beautiful card/phone-view or expansive cinematic view, but all touch targets must be mobile-optimized.
Use Lucide-React for icons (Play/Pause, Map Pin, Phone, Share).
Apply `font-['Cormorant_Garamond']` or `font-['Tiro_Devanagari_Hindi']` dynamically based on language state for headings.
For the map, use a standard Google Maps iframe embed with a generic Patna coordinate if exact isn't rendering nicely.
Implement the live countdown in standard React useEffect.
